subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable `systemPromptReport` contract should OpenClaw keep in session entries while fixing the remaining sessions.json bloat?
rationale: Current code and tests treat the report as load-bearing for warning dedupe, but field data shows the full report is now the dominant duplicated payload; automation should not choose that product/storage contract alone.

options.title: Persist minimal warning state inline
options.body: Keep only the small warning-dedupe state in session entries and strip or out-of-line the bulky tools, skills, and prompt report data.

options.title: Keep full reports inline
options.body: Accept the storage and parse cost to preserve the current debug/report shape exactly in each session entry.

options.title: Adopt skills-only cleanup first
options.body: Review or close the linked cross-repo PR separately, but track `systemPromptReport` as a follow-up before calling this issue fixed.

recommendation.title: Persist minimal warning state inline
recommendation.body: Keep only the small warning-dedupe state in session entries and strip or out-of-line the bulky tools, skills, and prompt report data.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent prompt-blob and session metadata history points to steipete as the clearest owner for the remaining storage-policy call.
